paragraphs: Many people in Ireland use a Leap card on buses and trains. You put money on the card before you travel.
Some people use auto top-up. When the card has less than €10, money goes on it from the bank. It adds €30, €40 or €50.
From Thursday, new users cannot sign up for auto top-up. People who already use it can keep it until their card expires.
But if it stops, for example when a card is lost, you cannot start it again.
Transport for Ireland says only about 1% of users have auto top-up. Most people, about 70%, use the phone app. The old system is also expensive to run.
sentZh: 愛爾蘭許多人搭公車和火車時使用Leap卡。
你在搭車前把錢存進卡裡。
有些人使用自動儲值。
當卡片餘額少於10歐元時，錢會從銀行轉入卡中。
它會加值30、40或50歐元。
從週四起，新用戶無法申請自動儲值。
已經在使用的人可以保留到卡片到期為止。
但如果它停止了，例如卡片遺失時，就不能再重新開始。
愛爾蘭交通局表示，只有約1%的用戶使用自動儲值。
大多數人（約70%）使用手機應用程式。
舊系統的營運費用也很高。

paragraphs: From Thursday, Leap card users in Ireland can no longer sign up for auto top-up. The Leap card is used to pay for buses, trains and trams.

With auto top-up, money is added to the card from a bank account when the balance falls below €10. The card is topped up with €30, €40 or €50. Some people liked it because they did not need to remember to add money, and it was useful for children's cards. But if there was not enough money in the bank account, the card was blocked.

Transport for Ireland (TFI) said people who already use auto top-up can keep it until their card expires. However, if it stops for any reason, such as a new bank account or a lost card, it cannot be set up again.

TFI said only about 1% of users have auto top-up, while about 70% add money through the app. It said the service is expensive, the old technology is difficult to maintain, and signing up was slow and difficult.
Some readers were unhappy and called the change a step backwards.
sentZh: 從週四起，愛爾蘭的Leap卡用戶不能再申請自動儲值。
Leap卡用來支付公車、火車和輕軌的車資。
使用自動儲值時，當卡片餘額低於10歐元，錢會從銀行帳戶轉入卡片。
卡片會被儲值30、40或50歐元。
有些人喜歡它，因為不必記得加值，而且很適合孩子的卡片。
但如果銀行帳戶裡的錢不夠，卡片就會被停用。
愛爾蘭交通局（TFI）表示，已在使用自動儲值的人可以保留到卡片到期。

它說這項服務成本高、舊技術難以維護，而且申請過程又慢又麻煩。
有些讀者感到不滿，稱這項改變是一種倒退。

paragraphs: Leap card users can no longer register for auto top-up from Thursday, Transport for Ireland (TFI) has confirmed.

The feature automatically adds €30, €40 or €50 to a card when its balance drops below €10. While some users valued it as a way to avoid last-minute top-ups, particularly on children's cards, others disliked the large sums involved. If a bank account lacked sufficient funds, the card was blocked.

Existing users will be able to keep the service until their card expires. However, if auto top-up ends for any reason, including a change of bank account, a lost or stolen card, or a failed direct debit, it cannot be reactivated.

A TFI spokesperson said only around 1% of users rely on auto top-up, while roughly 70% top up through the app. The authority said it was closing registrations because use of the service was falling, it was costly to operate and the older Leap technology was difficult to maintain. It also pointed to the poor experience of the manual, multi-step sign-up process.
Some readers criticised the move as a step backwards for public transport.

如果銀行帳戶資金不足，卡片就會被停用。

然而，如果自動儲值因任何原因結束，包括更換銀行帳戶、卡片遺失或被竊，或自動扣款失敗，就無法重新啟用。
TFI發言人表示，只有約1%的用戶依賴自動儲值，約70%透過應用程式加值。
該機構表示，停止受理登記是因為這項服務的使用量下降、營運成本高，而且舊的Leap技術難以維護。
它也提到人工多步驟申請流程的使用體驗不佳。
有些讀者批評此舉是公共交通的一大退步。

paragraphs: Transport for Ireland (TFI) has stopped accepting new registrations for Leap card auto top-up as of Thursday, quietly retiring a feature that had divided commuters.

The facility tops up a card with €30, €40 or €50 whenever its balance dips below €10. Devotees prized it for sparing them frantic last-minute top-ups, not least on children's cards, whereas detractors balked at the hefty sums. A shortfall in the linked bank account would leave the card blocked.

Current users may hold on to the service until their card expires. Should it lapse for any reason, however, whether through a switch of bank account, a lost or stolen card or a bounced direct debit, it cannot be revived.

According to a TFI spokesperson, a mere 1% or so of users avail of auto top-up, while some 70% top up via the app. The authority attributed the decision to dwindling uptake, steep running costs and the burden of maintaining ageing Leap technology, as well as a cumbersome manual registration process.
Some readers were scathing, branding the change a retrograde step.

每當卡片餘額跌破10歐元，這項服務就會為卡片儲值30、40或50歐元。
愛用者珍視它免去了手忙腳亂的臨時加值，尤其是孩子的卡片；批評者則對高額款項望而卻步。
綁定的銀行帳戶若餘額不足，卡片就會被停用。
現有用戶可以保留這項服務直到卡片到期。
不過，若它因任何原因失效，無論是更換銀行帳戶、卡片遺失或被竊，還是自動扣款被退回，都無法恢復。

該機構將這項決定歸因於使用率逐漸下降、營運成本高昂、維護老舊Leap技術的負擔，以及繁瑣的人工登記流程。
有些讀者言辭尖刻，斥這項改變為開倒車之舉。

paragraphs: With effect from Thursday, Transport for Ireland (TFI) will no longer accept new registrations for the Leap card auto top-up facility.

This function automatically credits a card with €30, €40 or €50 once its balance falls below €10. Although certain users regarded it as a convenient means of avoiding last-minute top-ups, particularly for children, others considered the amounts excessive. Furthermore, insufficient funds in the associated bank account resulted in the card being blocked.

Existing users may retain the service until their card expires. However, its continuation is contingent upon there being no interruption, since a change of bank account, a lost card or an unsuccessful direct debit would terminate it permanently.

A TFI spokesperson indicated that approximately 1% of users currently utilise auto top-up, whereas roughly 70% top up via the mobile application. The authority attributed the decision to declining usage, substantial operating costs and the difficulty of maintaining outdated technology, in addition to an inefficient manual registration procedure.
Consequently, some commuters criticised the change as a regressive step.
